original.introKicker: When a person needs to decide
original.introLede: Tell us what kind of work it is. You will get material to begin with on your own, and the roles or offices most likely to own the decision.
original.formTitle: What kind of help do you need?
original.formIntro: Describe the work in general terms. Leave out names, complaints and private case details.
original.timingPlaceholder: Choose when you need to act
original.oneDhsRouteNote: This points you to the person or office responsible for the work. Consultation requests are not collected on the public learning pages.
original.emptyResultTitle: Who can help will appear here
original.emptyResultBody: Answer the three questions and you will see a place to start on your own, plus the roles or offices most likely to hold the authority you need.
original.directoryNote: Use the current DHS staff directory, intranet, or your supervisor to confirm the named contact. Contact details appear here once the responsible office has confirmed them.
original.dsdOptionBody: Talk the work through within your existing, authorized workplace arrangements. Learning on this site informs a decision; it does not make one.
original.oneDhsDecisionBody: Start with program guidance, then contact the responsible person or office when a person needs to decide.
original.oneDsdDecisionBody: After using the support that fits your work, share a general request so it can be confirmed as DSD work.
original.roleError: Choose the role closest to your work.
original.taskError: Choose the area closest to your task.
original.timingError: Choose when you need to act.
original.urgencyExploratoryGuidance: You have room to review sources, involve people early, and shape the work before decisions harden.
original.urgencyWithin2WeeksLabel: I need support within two weeks
original.urgencyWithin2WeeksGuidance: Begin with the next decision and identify who needs to be involved before the two-week point.
original.urgencyHardDeadlineGuidance: Name the deadline and the decision that must be made, and leave time for responsible review.
original.urgencyLiveUrgentLabel: The work is already in use and needs prompt attention
original.urgencyLiveUrgentGuidance: Focus first on the immediate effect, who may be affected, and the responsible person who can act.
original.eligibilityNotCheckedLabel: I’m not sure whether this work is within One DSD
original.eligibilityNotCheckedDescription: Find the right person now, or confirm which division owns the work.
original.eligibilitySelfAttestedDsdLabel: This work is within the Disability Services Division
original.eligibilitySelfAttestedDsdDescription: See the people and offices responsible for this DSD work.
original.eligibilityNotDsdLabel: This work is outside the Disability Services Division
original.eligibilityNotDsdDescription: You will see the responsible person or office for your area.
original.destinationSupervisorOrManagerDescriptio: Start here when the next step depends on your team, role, workload, or decision authority.
original.destinationAdministrationEquityDirectorD: Contact the Equity Director responsible for the administration where the work sits.
original.destinationEquitySpecialistLabel: An Equity Specialist supporting your area
original.destinationEquitySpecialistDescription: Ask for practical equity support connected to the program, service, or decision.
original.destinationPolicyOrProgramOwnerLabel: The responsible policy or program owner
original.destinationPolicyOrProgramOwnerDescripti: Use the person or team with authority for the policy, program, service, or implementation decision.
original.destinationHumanResourcesDescription: Use the responsible Human Resources contact for workforce processes and official employment guidance.
original.destinationAccessibilityOrLanguageAccess: The responsible accessibility or language access lead
Use the lead or office responsible for access requirements, interpretation, translation, or accessible formats.
original.destinationProcurementOrContractOfficeLa: The responsible procurement or contract office
original.destinationProcurementOrContractOfficeDe: Use the office with authority for grant, procurement, contract, or fiscal requirements.
original.destinationDataOrQualityLeadLabel: The responsible data or quality lead
original.destinationDataOrQualityLeadDescription: Use the lead who can confirm data definitions, protections, quality, and appropriate interpretation.
original.destinationCommunityEngagementLeadDescri: Use the lead or office responsible for community relationships, participation, and follow-through.
original.destinationCivilRightsChannelDescription: Use the formal channel for a complaint, investigation, discrimination concern, or protected process.
original.destinationOfficeOfIndianPolicyOrTribalL: The Office of Indian Policy or the responsible Tribal liaison
Use the separate government-to-government or Tribal relations process when it applies.
original.destinationCommunicationsOrPublicInforma: The responsible communications or public information office
Use the office responsible for the message, its release, the channel, and the public response.
